attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This changes core shape-binding override/merge semantics in the display engine (shared by every theme and module across all tenants), and the new 'first-source-wins per ShapeDescriptorIndex' logic depends on feature iteration order in subtle ways that could silently change which view/binding is selected for existing sites despite the added test."}

reason: This changes core shape-binding override/merge semantics in the display engine (shared by every theme and module across all tenants), and the new 'first-source-wins per ShapeDescriptorIndex' logic depends on feature iteration order in subtle ways that could silently change which view/binding is selected for existing sites despite the added test.
